independentRecheck.scope: Same retained actual linked-worktree remove/replace inputs, reload empty rules, unknown fields, directory revoke and additive legacy byte preservation; entry hashes stable

adaptation.paths: Existing canonical Git-root path plus optional cwd legacyLocalSettings. No projectConfigDir product surface exists.
adaptation.transform: The existing permission update switch is one transform used for canonical and cloned legacy objects. Canonical writes first, then vxs recursion intersects old legacy arrays by JSON equality, retains original scalar leaves and surviving original keys. New rules, directories and defaultMode remain canonical only.
adaptation.unchanged: Canonical null/no-content-change still evaluates legacy revocation. Aggregate written reports either changed document.
adaptation.errors: Missing legacy, malformed JSON and nonobject JSON preserve original bytes and remain unchanged. Read/transform errors retain phase. Cr marks all array patches removal-bearing, including additive rules/directories; only scalar setMode patches can return canonical success with warning after legacy evaluation error. Legacy publication errors always return error. Canonical read/write failure stops before legacy.
adaptation.queue: Acquire both resolved file queue keys in sorted order. All updates naming either file use the existing per-file queues. Shared canonical roots and overlapping destination paths serialize without lock-order cycles. No recursive acquisition of one key.
adaptation.host: Node atomicWriteFile keeps file mode, byte verification and parent identity. Existing strict regular-file and byte-limit boundaries remain. Source storageV5 publication, source cache observers and automatic local gitignore updates remain outside this bounded local-JSON persistence adaptation.

validation.regressions: Extended the existing second W183 group only. Literal allow/deny/ask remove and replace, unchanged canonical revocation, directories, unknown fields, absent additive legacy keys, defaultMode preservation, malformed/nonobject JSON, read/transform/write errors, scalar warning and overlapping-path concurrent writes. Existing first-group memory-first and independent-owner assertions retained.
